title: The White Room
body: Cedric Price’s famous all-white room, located at the top of an Edwardian building in Alfred Place, just off Tottenham Court Road in London, was sparsely furnished - just a couple of chairs and a desk, on which stands an Anglepoise lamp, an ashtray and a decanter of brandy. As you toiled up the stairs you pass notices - "Wipe your feet!" and (on the next landing) "And again!". The all-white room is not just a bolt-hole where the famously sociable Price retires to think and smoke one of his favourite cigars: it was a power-house of radical ideas.
